description:
Hushfeed v0.20.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: press and hold the left or right edge to jump back or forward, show the whole of a video on a screen that is not 9:16, switches for the new follower notification and for message streaks, a switch to keep the screen's own refresh rate, saving a video without its sound or handing its link to a downloader you already use, allowing Duet and Stitch on videos that closed them, a box above the comments that narrows them, a local creator-hide action with a searchable list, a publication-age feed filter, a discovered share-action checklist with stable identifiers, a documented YTDLnis handoff profile for audio, video and background mode, and an optional limit for Hushfeed-owned automatic advance; interrupted Feature Gate recordings are discarded before the next baseline.

Validation: 460 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 68 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads; every patch but AMOLED dark theme applied to a stock 46.2.3 APK in one run at 640 MB, the only miss being the known Downloads fingerprint. Diagnostic exports redact signed URLs and credentials before they are copied or saved. None of the new switches has been seen on a phone: the roadmap lists a device check for each one.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
